lee: Heads up — ACME reported a 401 invalid_api_key for all requests since we rolled the edge-worker rewrite at 02:12 UTC.
lee: Repro steps from their side: browser -> our CDN -> edge-worker rewrite -> origin. Fails only when rewrite rule runs.
lee: Quick curl they sent:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXYYZZ\" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/chat/completions
```
lee: Response shows 401 with no other errors. They verified the same key works if they bypass the edge-worker (direct to origin).
devon: Can you paste the edge-worker snippet? Could be clobbering headers during path rewrite.
lee: Here's the worker config they deployed (sanitized):
```
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const req = event.request;
  // rewrite path and proxy
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  url.pathname = url.pathname.replace('/acme-proxy/', '/v1/');
  // they used a manual header override here
  const newHeaders = new Headers(req.headers);
  newHeaders.set('Host', url.host);
  newHeaders.set('Authorization', ''); // <-- suspicious
  const proxied = new Request(url.toString(), { method: req.method, headers: newHeaders, body: req.body });
  event.respondWith(fetch(proxied));
});
```
lee: The key thing: they accidentally set Authorization to an empty string rather than leaving it untouched.
ashok: That would definitely trigger invalid_api_key since gateway sees an Authorization header but contents empty. We treat empty as invalid rather than missing.
devon: @lee, can you get a request/response capture showing headers at origin? We need the trace id. Also ask them whether any other edge rules mutate headers (HSTS, remove-sensitive-headers, etc.).
support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-4823 — Escalate: acme-inc 401 after edge-worker rewrite. Assigned to eng-infra.
sre-oncall: If we need to patch quickly, we can short-term accept empty Authorization as 'missing' for legacy proxies, but I'd rather fix client. File a short rollback or provide a patch note.
lee: Trace id from their failing request: trace_id=trc_0a1b2c3d
lee: Origin received header: `Authorization:` (empty). Our gateway logs:
```
[2026-03-12T02:15:18Z] trace=trc_0a1b2c3d method=POST path=/v1/chat/completions status=401 auth_header_present=true auth_header_value_len=0
```
devon: Ok that proves it. Action items:
- lee: ask ACME to revert worker or remove the `newHeaders.set('Authorization', '')` line (quickest).
- devon: prepare a small doc for customers showing how to preserve Authorization when rewriting paths in edge workers (examples for Cloudflare Workers, Fastly, Netlify Edge, etc.).
- ashok: will check whether gateway should treat zero-length Authorization as missing and log a clearer message to avoid confusion.
ashok: For now, @lee, offer ACME a temporary workaround: set the header explicitly to the existing Authorization value using `req.headers.get('Authorization')` instead of emptying it, or skip setting Authorization at all.
lee: Sent the workaround to the customer and scheduled a call in 30m. Closing loop once they confirm.
support-bot: SUP-4823 updated: customer notified, workaround suggested, awaiting confirmation.
devon: Leaving a follow-up item to eng-infra: add a linter/check in our edge-worker examples to catch header-clobbering patterns.
lee: Thanks all :thumbsup:
